Tooltip_TREK_Shuttle: A Starfleet shuttlecraft. It needs a street or a field to set down on, not a hallway.
Tooltip_TREK_Phaser: Starfleet sidearm. The charge never runs down, it never jams and it never wears out. Quieter than a firearm, which is most of the point.
Tooltip_TREK_RationPack: Starfleet emergency rations. Dense, keeps forever, and tastes better than anything you will find in a dead man's pantry.
Tooltip_TREK_Gagh: Klingon serpent worms, best served live. Very filling. A Klingon would enjoy this. You are not a Klingon.
Tooltip_TREK_LeolaStew: Neelix's signature dish. Genuinely nourishing. Nobody has ever asked for seconds.
Tooltip_TREK_PlomeekSoup: A clear Vulcan vegetable broth. Light, calming, and logically nourishing.
Tooltip_TREK_JumjaStick: Bajoran jumja sap, crystallised on a stick. Hardly a meal. Wonderful anyway.
Tooltip_TREK_AndorianTuber: An Andorian root, roasted. Dense, sweet and very high in calories, which on a frozen world is the whole point.
Tooltip_TREK_Oskoid: A Betazoid delicacy: dark yellow leaves with purple veins, kept warm by their own sap. Light, lovely, and gone too fast.
Tooltip_TREK_WingSlugRoll: An Orion snack: wing-slugs rolled in a green wrapper. Orions eat them by the dozen. The wings are the crunchy part.
Tooltip_TREK_Hasperat: A Bajoran wrap in a brine hot enough to make your eyes water. Only good when it's warm. Have a drink ready.
Tooltip_TREK_RokegPie: A Klingon blood pie, rich and dark, and filling enough for a warrior's feast. Traditionally eaten on the Day of Honor.
Tooltip_TREK_Chadrekab: A Talaxian delicacy, steamed from a family recipe. Genuinely delicious, which is more than the leola root can say.
Tooltip_TREK_Raktajino: Klingon coffee, double strong. It will keep you on your feet through a night watch and most of the next one.
Tooltip_TREK_EarlGrey: Tea. Earl Grey. Hot. Nothing out here is calm, but this comes close.
Tooltip_TREK_RomulanAle: Luminous blue, thoroughly illegal, and considerably stronger than it looks. Sip it.
Tooltip_TREK_Bloodwine: Klingon bloodwine, at spirit strength. Traditionally drunk from the barrel, in company, loudly.
Tooltip_TREK_AndorianAle: Andorian ale: blue, served cold enough to hurt, and drunk in shots. Stronger than it tastes.
Tooltip_TREK_BalsoTonic: A mild Trill tonic, faintly medicinal. Settles the nerves. No replicator has ever got it right, this one included.
Tooltip_TREK_NutrientSuspension: A semi-organic nutrient suspension in a silicon-based liquid medium, for keeping an android lubricated. A human can live on it. Barely.
Tooltip_TREK_Batleth: A Klingon bat'leth, the sword of honour. Two hands, a wide sweep, and it is still moving after the first one.
Tooltip_TREK_Mekleth: A Klingon mek'leth. Shorter than a bat'leth and quicker for it, swept forward so the weight is always ahead of your hand.
Tooltip_TREK_Lirpa: A Vulcan lirpa. A blade at one end, a weight at the other, and enough reach to keep the dead at the far end of it. Logic does not enter into it.
Tooltip_TREK_UshaanTor: An Andorian ushaan-tor. An ice miner's hooked blade, and the tool of a duel that traditionally ends when one of you cannot continue.
Tooltip_TREK_Hypospray: A Starfleet hypospray. One dose puts right very nearly everything a body can have gone wrong with it. Very nearly. It will not touch a bite.
Tooltip_TREK_MedTricorder: A medical tricorder. It reads a body the way a surgeon would, whether or not you have ever held a scalpel.
Tooltip_TREK_Tricorder: A Starfleet tricorder. Sweeps for lifesigns well past what you can see, and talks most electronic locks open. Not padlocks; those are somebody's own.
Tooltip_TREK_DermalRegen: Run it over the skin and the skin closes: cuts, scratches, deep wounds, burns, and the stitches and dressings that were holding them together. It does nothing for an infected wound, a broken bone or a bite, and it will not close over glass.
Tooltip_TREK_Replicator: The ship's replicator. It makes anything it holds a pattern for, out of a reserve that fills itself back up given a few hours. Scan a thing once and the ship can make it for ever.
Tooltip_TREK_WarpCore: The shuttle's power plant. It burns one dilithium crystal at a time and loads a spare when that one is spent. When there are no spares, the replicator stops. Stand at it to load a crystal or take one back.
Tooltip_TREK_Dilithium: A lattice of dilithium. Everything aboard the shuttle runs on one at a time, and nothing aboard can make more. They turn up lying in the wild ground of the county, never in town, and nobody has explained why. Load them into the warp core amidships.
Tooltip_TREK_EMH: The sick bay's holographic doctor. Diagnosis, treatment and supplies without end, and the only thing aboard that will cure a zombie bite. It costs one dilithium crystal and twelve hours in the ship.
Tooltip_TREK_UniformDuty: Standard issue: a one-piece duty uniform in division colours, with the combadge at the left breast. Warm, hard-wearing and no protection at all against anything with teeth.
Tooltip_TREK_UniformDress: Formal dress uniform. Long and heavy, worn for ceremonies rather than away missions. It will keep the cold off and slow you down.
Tooltip_TREK_Tape: A 20th-century videocassette. The shuttle's television is also its tape player.
Tooltip_TREK_PADD: Personal Access Display Device. Right-click a book with this on you to load a copy; right-click the PADD to read, copy or erase its library. Reading off a PADD is five times faster than paper.
Tooltip_TREK_Fragment: A holo recording, three hundred years old. Hail the Adirondack with it on you: Shepard can put it on tape, where it cannot be lost.
